\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\offset}{2}
\begin{document}
\begin{definition}\label{train:offset}Write $d=\offset$.\end{definition}
\begin{theorem}\label{train:macro}
For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[(x+\offset)^2=x^2+4x+4.\]
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}Use Definition~\ref{train:offset}.\end{proof}
\end{document}
